chunks: God will pay them on that day their just due in full, and they will come to know that God is the tangible Reality.

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God pays people their 'just due' on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the hiddenness of faith in this world to the manifest certainty (yaqin) on the Day of Judgment, where God fulfills the 'true due' (haqq) of every soul. It underscores the concept of divine justice (Adl), where the reality of God becomes self-evident to all, fulfilling the promise that no deed, however small, will be lost.
